design_philosophy: The fully-specced expression of ASUS's big-screen thin-and-light: max Ryzen AI silicon, 32GB/1TB, and the 3K 120Hz touch OLED in the sub-1.5 kg Ceraluminum chassis. It targets creators-on-the-go who want OLED colour and multitasking headroom without gaming-laptop weight.
